title: Chlorine addition with inline quench
protocol: An alkene solution at 0.20 M is exposed to 1.05 equivalents of chlorine gas at 0 C for 30 min in batch, then quenched with aqueous sodium thiosulfate. Translate to flow with explicit gas dosing and off-gas handling.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
